import asyncio
from robotblocks_runtime import *
from machine import Pin, time_pulse_us
import time

def ultrasonico_cm(trig, echo):
    trig.value(0)
    time.sleep_us(2)
    trig.value(1)
    time.sleep_us(10)
    trig.value(0)
    duracion = time_pulse_us(echo, 1, 30000)
    if duracion < 0:
        return 400  # Sin eco: fuera de alcance.
    return round(duracion / 58, 1)


ultra_trig_25 = Pin(25, Pin.OUT, value=0)
ultra_echo_27 = Pin(27, Pin.IN)

async def proceso_1():
    while True:
        print(ultrasonico_cm(ultra_trig_25, ultra_echo_27))
        await rb_wait(0.5)
        await rb_yield()

async def main():
    await rb_run(proceso_1)

asyncio.run(main())
